title: Fix TypeScript Build Script File Breachs
description: Fix code policy breachs in TypeScript build/script files. Add proper section regions to wrap orphan definitions, and summary+spec comments.
summary: Added section regions around orphan code and summary+spec comments for definitions in 5 engine TypeScript files: build.ts (Build section, cwd/args defs), generate-schemas.ts (Schema Generation section), test.ts (Test Runner section), sqliteschema.ts (Schema Export section, dbPath/outputPath defs), post-build.ts (Post Build section, 6 path constant defs)
